reason: After a successful enable, apps/web/components/settings/EnableTwoFactorModal.tsx:135 only sets the DisplayBackupCodes step; `onEnable()` and `resetState()` run solely in the Close button handler (lines 266-270). Escape or overlay click goes through `onOpenChange` (apps/web/pages/settings/security/two-factor-auth.tsx:64), which just toggles the open flag without invalidating `viewer.me`, and the always-mounted modal keeps the stale step on reopen. There is no X button in Dialog.tsx, but that does not change the outcome.
